spec.name: M7.RecoveryPrefix.completed_partition
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (w : ℕ) (E : Finset M5.BinaryPolynomial) (p : List Bool), p.length < M7.PrefixBits.depth N → M7.RecoveryPrefix.completed N w E p = M7.RecoveryPrefix.completed N w E (p ++ [false]) ∪ M7.RecoveryPrefix.completed N w E (p ++ [true]) ∧ Disjoint (M7.RecoveryPrefix.completed N w E (p ++ [false])) (M7.RecoveryPrefix.completed N w E (p ++ [true]))
spec.guidance: Actual completed is the decodePair image of PrefixBits.completed. Apply the accepted natural completed_partition then image_union. For disjointness, two equal decoded members have equal natural supports by ResiduePrefix.decode_injective, using completed_bounds and PrefixBits.base (N>0 follows NeZero). Then apply natural child disjointness. Do not assume image injectivity without its verified bounds. Return tactic lines without leading by; keep exact frozen target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.RecoveryPrefix.completed_subroot
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (w : ℕ) (E : Finset M5.BinaryPolynomial) (p : List Bool), M7.RecoveryPrefix.completed N w E p ⊆ M7.RecoveryPrefix.completed N w E []
spec.guidance: Use ResiduePrefix.completed_membership and PrefixBits.base on p and []. Both share the actual Valid predicate. PrefixBits.root gives selected {0} and remaining range N minus {0}. Membership in the p completion implies zero selected in both natural supports and bounds within range N; use PrefixCompleted.Base and Within, or completed_bounds on a natural preimage. Thus it satisfies the root Within test. No signature-sector or class-validity extra hypothesis is required. Return tactic lines without leading by; keep exact frozen target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.RecoveryPrefix.leaf_singleton
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (w : ℕ) (E : Finset M5.BinaryPolynomial) (p : List Bool), p.length = M7.PrefixBits.depth N → M7.RecoveryPrefix.completed N w E p ⊆ {M7.RecoveryPrefix.leaf N p}
spec.guidance: Unfold the actual completed/leaf as decodePair image. PrefixBits.leaf_singleton says the natural completion set lies in the one selected pair. Any image member is therefore exactly the decoded leaf. Include N=1 depth zero and empty/invalid completion sets without an existence assumption. Return tactic lines without leading by; keep exact frozen target and default limits.
